description: Express.js route handlers for user management, including fetching users, handling account requests, approval, rejection, revocation, and profile updates.

methods.name: GET /users
methods.description: Fetch all users with optional filters for status, role, and search; admin only.

methods.name: GET /users/requests
methods.description: Retrieve pending account requests; admin only.

methods.name: POST /users/:userId/approve
methods.description: Approve a user account request, set status to active and assign role; admin only.

methods.name: POST /users/:userId/reject
methods.description: Reject a user account request, remove user and notify; admin only.

methods.name: POST /users/:userId/revoke
methods.description: Revoke a user account, set status to revoked and notify; admin only.

methods.name: PATCH /users/:userId
methods.description: Update user details such as email, name, role, status, professional title; admin only.

methods.name: GET /users/:userId
methods.description: Retrieve user profile by ID, accessible to admin, owner, or special admin email accounts.
